_comment: Per-surface switches. `off` means the hook entry is absent from .claude/settings.local.json entirely. `capture_only` and `shadow` are worker-side: the hook ALWAYS captures when registered, because capture is cheap and a captured state is permanently replayable. `enforce` is NOT reachable from this file — it requires registering a different script, so a passive observer can never become a blocker by way of a typo.
